$comment: AI-3 EXECUTABLE MUTATION MANIFEST M41-M61, CURRENT EXPLICIT SCHEMA (v4). The strict verifier reads ONLY the current-schema keys listed in `current_schema_authoritative_keys`. Everything under `notes` is historical or forensic prose and everything under `legacy` is a retired historical field; neither is ever read by the parser or the executor (proved by a differential strip self-test that re-normalizes the manifest with both blocks deleted and requires a byte-identical obligation set).

schema.SINGLE: exactly one obligation; the row IS the obligation. `designation`, `witness` and `expected_verdict` are explicit row fields. The obligation resolves its mutation through the explicit `mutation_owner` reference; a row that defines `mutation` is that owner's definition.
schema.TYPE_B_MULTI_PREDICATE: one obligation per `subobligations` entry, each with its own explicit `obligation_id`, `designation`, `witness`, `expected_verdict` and `mutation_owner`.
schema.VARIANT_SET: one obligation per `variants` entry. `components` on a variant declares WHICH row-owned component mutations are active; the semantic `expected_verdict` is declared explicitly per variant and is NEVER inferred from the component set.
schema.SHARED_GUARD_SCENARIO: one mutation definition on the row, one obligation per `scenarios` entry, every scenario pointing at the same explicit `mutation_owner`.
schema.RETIRED_BY_ARCHITECTURE: non-destructive pin. `expected_verdict` is RETIRED_BY_ARCHITECTURE; it never enters the destructive executor and never owns a mutation.
schema.expected_verdict: REQUIRED and EXPLICIT on every verdict-bearing obligation. One of CAUGHT | SURVIVED_AS_EXPECTED | PIN_GREEN | RETIRED_BY_ARCHITECTURE. There is no default and no prose inference; an absent or unknown token is STRUCTURAL_INVALID.
schema.mutation_owner: REQUIRED on every destructive obligation. It is the id of the record that DEFINES the mutation. Owners are SINGLE rows, SHARED_GUARD_SCENARIO rows, VARIANT_SET rows and self-mutating subobligations. A sharer MUST NOT carry its own `mutation` definition.

$migration_v4.reconciled_missing_nine: The strict current-schema parser produced 23 obligations from 21 historical rows. The nine genuinely missing strict obligations are M43, M47a, M47b, M51, M56a, M56b, M59, M60 and M61; 23 + 9 = 32.
$migration_v4.m43_m51_m59_m60_m61: Migrated from the legacy `mutate` shape to explicit SINGLE rows with an inline `mutation` and an explicit expected_verdict of CAUGHT.
$migration_v4.m47a_m47b: M47's legacy `submutations` had no explicit expected verdict (they carried prose), so both sub-obligations were previously dropped. They are now explicit subobligations with obligation ids M47a / M47b, exact designations AI3-M47A-HIST / AI3-M47B-HIST, their own witness, their own mutation and expected_verdict CAUGHT. The prior prose moved to `reason` / `notes`.
$migration_v4.m56a_m56b: M56's legacy submutations were keyed by `sub`, not `id`, so both were dropped. They are now explicit subobligations with obligation ids M56a / M56b, exact designations AI3-M56A-HIST / AI3-M56B-HIST and expected_verdict CAUGHT. The legacy `sub` key is no longer authoritative.
$migration_v4.m42_m57: Both rows already existed as semantic obligations but resolved no mutation definition, so both were unexecutable. They are now SINGLE sharers carrying mutation_owner = M41. M41 remains the sole owner of the shared stronger-source conflict mutation; neither sharer duplicates its file, anchor or replacement. No obligation was added for either row.
$migration_v4.m54: M54 was one historical row with one shared mutation but four scenario obligations the strict parser classified as non-destructive because the shared mutation was not in the schema it consumed. It is now row_type SHARED_GUARD_SCENARIO with ONE mutation definition and FOUR explicitly destructive scenario obligations (userMasses / portions / countPortions / householdPortions), each with its own designation, witness and expected_verdict CAUGHT, each pointing at mutation_owner M54.
$migration_v4.m50_m53: The old parser compared a variant's letter string against the `applies_components` list, which is a type-impossible comparison. The component set now only declares WHICH mutations are active; the semantic expected verdict is declared explicitly per variant (M50 AB / ABC = SURVIVED_AS_EXPECTED, ABCD = CAUGHT; M53 A / B = SURVIVED_AS_EXPECTED, AB = CAUGHT).
$migration_v4.no_verdict_defaults: The implicit `row.get('expected_verdict', CAUGHT)` default was removed. Every verdict-bearing obligation now declares its expected verdict explicitly in current metadata; an absent or unknown token is a structural problem.
